evidence.title: Popular US airport called out as 'most stressful' in America for travelers

occurrences.checkable_against: Rightway Parking airport stress ranking
occurrences.quote_span: After the analysis, Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) was ranked as the "most stressful" airport in the country in the study.
occurrences.speaker: Rightway Parking
occurrences.subject: U.S. airport stress ranking

occurrences.checkable_against: Rightway Parking airport stress analysis and Bureau of Transportation Statistics flight data
occurrences.quote_span: DFW was followed by Chicago O'Hare International Airport, which took the No. 2 spot with 24.68% of flights delayed and a 42.77% increase in delays since 2021.
occurrences.speaker: Rightway Parking
occurrences.subject: U.S. airport stress ranking

occurrences.checkable_against: Rightway Parking airport stress analysis
occurrences.quote_span: Rightway Parking, an airport and cruise parking reservation company based in Tampa, Florida, analyzed 55 airports using federal flight data and Google Maps estimates.
occurrences.speaker: Rightway Parking
occurrences.subject: U.S. airport stress ranking

occurrences.checkable_against: Rightway Parking airport stress analysis and Bureau of Transportation Statistics flight data
occurrences.quote_span: The airport has also seen delays climb 33.67% since 2021, according to the report.
occurrences.speaker: Rightway Parking
occurrences.subject: U.S. airport stress ranking

occurrences.checkable_against: Rightway Parking airport stress analysis methodology
occurrences.quote_span: It weighed delays, cancellations, changes in delays, and the distance and travel time from downtown areas.
occurrences.speaker: Rightway Parking
occurrences.subject: U.S. airport stress ranking

occurrences.checkable_against: Rightway Parking airport stress analysis and Bureau of Transportation Statistics flight data
occurrences.quote_span: It has seen delays increase 73.92% since 2021, according to the analysis.
occurrences.speaker: Rightway Parking
occurrences.subject: U.S. airport stress ranking

occurrences.checkable_against: Rightway Parking airport stress ranking
occurrences.quote_span: DFW was followed by Chicago O'Hare International Airport, which took the No. 2 spot with 24.68% of flights delayed and a 42.77% increase in delays since 2021.
occurrences.speaker: Rightway Parking
occurrences.subject: U.S. airport stress ranking

occurrences.checkable_against: Rightway Parking airport stress ranking
occurrences.quote_span: Rounding out the top three was Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport in Arlington, Virginia, just across the Potomac River from Washington, D.C.
occurrences.speaker: Rightway Parking
occurrences.subject: U.S. airport stress ranking

occurrences.checkable_against: Rightway Parking airport stress ranking
occurrences.quote_span: New York City's John F. Kennedy International Airport and Philadelphia International Airport rounded out the top five, ranking fourth and fifth.
occurrences.speaker: Rightway Parking
occurrences.subject: U.S. airport stress ranking

occurrences.checkable_against: Bureau of Transportation Statistics 2025 flight data and Rightway Parking analysis
occurrences.quote_span: Reagan National recorded a 3.86% cancellation rate.
occurrences.speaker: Rightway Parking
occurrences.subject: U.S. airport stress ranking

occurrences.checkable_against: Bureau of Transportation Statistics 2025 flight data, Google Maps estimates and Rightway Parking analysis
occurrences.quote_span: All three recorded cancellation rates below 1% and had relatively shorter trips from downtown compared with many of the airports toward the top of the ranking.
occurrences.speaker: Rightway Parking
occurrences.subject: U.S. airport stress ranking

occurrences.checkable_against: Bureau of Transportation Statistics 2025 flight data and Rightway Parking analysis
occurrences.quote_span: DFW was followed by Chicago O'Hare International Airport, which took the No. 2 spot with 24.68% of flights delayed and a 42.77% increase in delays since 2021.
occurrences.speaker: Rightway Parking
occurrences.subject: U.S. airport stress ranking

occurrences.checkable_against: Bureau of Transportation Statistics 2025 flight data and Rightway Parking analysis
occurrences.quote_span: Nearly 28% of flights at DFW were delayed, while 2.76% were canceled, according to the analysis, which used 2025 flight data from the Bureau of Transportation Statistics.

occurrences.subject: U.S. airport stress ranking

occurrences.quote_span: Nearly 28% of flights at DFW were delayed, while 2.76% were canceled, according to the analysis, which used 2025 flight data from the Bureau of Transportation Statistics.

occurrences.subject: U.S. airport stress ranking

occurrences.checkable_against: Google Maps travel-time estimate from downtown Chicago to Chicago O'Hare International Airport
occurrences.quote_span: Travel time also factored into O'Hare's position, with the drive from downtown Chicago to the airport estimated at about 50 minutes.

occurrences.subject: U.S. airport stress ranking

occurrences.checkable_against: Rightway Parking airport stress ranking
occurrences.quote_span: Salt Lake City International Airport in Utah was ranked the "least stressful" airport — followed by San Jose International Airport in California and Daniel K. Inouye International Airport in Honolulu, Hawaii.
occurrences.speaker: Rightway Parking
occurrences.subject: U.S. airport stress ranking
